title: SLASH · The clipping
venue: Box 4B · sixty pages · never lettered for print
logline: Behind the frame shop's counter, in the drawer with the pins, a clipping the owner cut from a wire story years ago: a riverboat lost when the ground opened under a Louisiana town. The framer reads it twice and puts it back under the pins.

panels.composition: Full page: the drawer open, pushpins scattered, a yellowed newspaper clipping with a photo of a riverboat listing beside a ragged hole in a street, the headline drawn as blocks; the owner's shadow across the drawer from the doorway.

image.prompt: black and white noir comic page, brush-pen over blue pencil, rain as dense vertical hatching, stark black spotting, an open drawer with scattered pushpins and a yellowed newspaper clipping showing a riverboat listing beside a ragged hole in a street, the headline as black blocks, a man's shadow falling across it from a doorway
image.notes: The Sinkhole (Vol 5's Nexus). Headline reserved; drawn as blocks. The owner says the name; the framer is the framer.

art.line: brush-pen over rough blue pencil; rain in frantic vertical hatching; stark spotting; Arc 1's aesthetic pushed to noir
